span.label: Where the boundary falls between what an art-historical research project can express as Linked Open Data and what it must leave as prose.

span.label: Structured vocabularies buy accuracy and queryability - so what is lost when the reflexive, contextual part of humanities research is forced into them?

span.label: Argues that only the quantitative, queryable part of art-historical research is worth modelling as triples, and bridges the rest to it through visual interfaces rather than forcing it into ontologies.
